ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the CAMS ticket was ingested into the raw-data store

reportFolder.description: Source folder of the ingested report

title.description: Ticket title taken from the Jira issue summary

key.description: Jira issue key uniquely identifying the CAMS ticket

affected_systems.description: Ground segment systems affected by the anomaly (Jira affected-systems field)

criticality.description: Criticality level of the anomaly (Jira criticality field)

urgency.description: Urgency level of the anomaly (Jira urgency field)

originating_entity.description: Entity that originated the ticket (Jira originating-entity field)

entity.description: Primary entity responsible for the ticket (Jira entity field)

assigned_element.description: Element(s) the ticket is assigned to (Jira assigned-element field)

review_board_dispositions.description: Review board dispositions recorded on the ticket (Jira field)

reporter.description: Display name of the Jira user who reported the ticket

involved_entities.description: Entities involved in the ticket (Jira involved-entities field)

created.description: Date the CAMS ticket was created in Jira

updated.description: Date the CAMS ticket was last updated in Jira

occurence_date.description: Date the anomaly occurred (Jira occurrence-date field)

status.description: Current workflow status of the Jira ticket

environment.description: Environment description of the ticket (Jira environment field)

linked_issues.description: Keys of Jira issues linked to this ticket

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced the record
